original_CT36.name: flat-binary-complete
original_CT36.input_boundary: Original flat observer, empty target arguments, complete source/output/workspace and binary stdout/stderr.

original_CT36.name: linked-binary-complete
original_CT36.input_boundary: Original linked observer and actual return snapshot; full pre-finalizer and post-finalizer buffers remain separate.

original_CT36.name: flat-env
original_CT36.input_boundary: Target emits its actual environment; original exact PATH/LANG/LC_ALL/TZ only.

original_CT36.name: linked-inherited-env
original_CT36.input_boundary: Inherited environment with extra parent variable, actual exec, no flat sanitization.

original_CT36.name: argv
original_CT36.input_boundary: Empty and nonempty arguments, exact argv[0] naming form and argument bytes; original first.

original_CT36.name: stdin-empty
original_CT36.input_boundary: Real empty stdin closes before target read and preserves EOF.

original_CT36.name: stdin-many-pipe-windows
original_CT36.input_boundary: Request larger than PIPE_BUF and pipe capacity; every byte consumed.

original_CT36.name: stdout-multiple-reads
original_CT36.input_boundary: Binary output exceeds 32768 and includes NUL, invalid UTF-8, and frame magic in ordinary payload.

original_CT36.name: stderr-multiple-reads
original_CT36.input_boundary: Independent binary stderr exceeds one read window.

original_CT36.name: both-streams-backpressure
original_CT36.input_boundary: Target writes enough to both pipes while reading stdin; no deadlock or dropped bytes.

original_CT36.name: early-stdin-close
original_CT36.input_boundary: Target closes fd0 before consuming input; EPIPE is not promoted to a target failure.

original_CT36.name: exit-nonzero
original_CT36.input_boundary: Real nonzero exit, exact signed returncode and full raw streams.

original_CT36.name: sigill
original_CT36.input_boundary: Actual SIGILL; raw wait status and shared output remain visible.

original_CT36.name: missing-cwd
original_CT36.input_boundary: Real chdir failure, no exec-success claim, error stage/errno retained, child reaped.

original_CT36.name: invalid-executable
original_CT36.input_boundary: Sealed non-ELF image produces actual exec error; no invented target return.

original_CT36.name: empty-executable
original_CT36.input_boundary: Empty executable still creates/seals then fails at exec, with no preemptive content validator.

original_CT36.name: timeout-point-one
original_CT36.input_boundary: Existing .1-second real pause target; PID disappears and all private fds close.

original_CT36.name: timeout-partial-raw
original_CT36.input_boundary: Raw stdout/stderr emitted before timeout retained exactly; no cleanup drain appends post-timeout bytes.

original_CT36.name: timeout-before-first-read
original_CT36.input_boundary: Preserve distinguishable read-count zero versus a genuine empty EOF read for later Python None/bytes conversion.

original_CT36.name: wait-timeout
original_CT36.input_boundary: Target closes all stdio pipes but stays alive; classify wait timeout separately from communicate timeout.

original_CT36.name: timeout-zero
original_CT36.input_boundary: Deadline begins after successful exec handshake; retain real partial/no-read facts.

original_CT36.name: borrowed-output-fd
original_CT36.input_boundary: Exact passed output fd remains open in parent and is not renumbered or closed by transport.

original_CT36.name: borrowed-snapshot-fd
original_CT36.input_boundary: Both distinct borrowed output and snapshot fds preserved through exec; original linked semantics.

original_CT36.name: unexpected-stdout
original_CT36.input_boundary: Constructor/callback noise is preserved; unchanged invoke parser decides refusal.

original_CT36.name: no-extra-process
original_CT36.input_boundary: Exactly one fresh target child, same process group/session as original; no worker reuse.

original_CT36.name: source-drift
original_CT36.input_boundary: Every original invoke source/image/observer read and terminal reread remains active; no new cache.

original_CT36.name: policy-short-response
original_CT36.input_boundary: Invalid policy return must take real emergency kill/reap/close and report POLICY_LOST.

original_CT36.name: nonce-sequence
original_CT36.input_boundary: Wrong nonce/repeated sequence/ACK action or argument is rejected before dispatch.

original_CT36.name: request-canary
original_CT36.input_boundary: Changed request/canary/output envelope rejected before any requested OS action.

original_CT36.name: resource-command-shape
original_CT36.input_boundary: Invalid slot, duplicate close, second fork, or out-of-bounds write is rejected before syscall.

original_CT36.name: real-extent-and-seals
original_CT36.input_boundary: Actual executable memfd bytes and seal bits; no boolean stand-in for fcntl observations.

original_CT36.name: fresh-state
original_CT36.input_boundary: Each call has fresh HIA workspace, pipes, sealed memfd, process, captures, and nonce.

original_CT36.name: trace-overflow-is-hold
original_CT36.input_boundary: Diagnostic trace overflow does not truncate raw output or change original domain, and cannot be reported complete.

original_CT36.name: closed-stdio-profile-refusal
original_CT36.input_boundary: New typed profile explicitly refuses missing standard fds; never claim old Python all-input compatibility.

original_CT36.name: signal-profile-refusal
original_CT36.input_boundary: New typed profile explicitly refuses incompatible SIGPIPE/SIGCHLD dispositions; no hidden mutation.

original_CT36.name: owner-lost
original_CT36.input_boundary: A real competing wait/ECHILD, if exercised in an isolated control, must remain CUSTODY_LOST, never reaped=true.

original_CT36_status: Mandatory broader protocol/native matrix retained as declared; this package does not claim it executed or fully implemented by the eight atomic-handoff controls.
additional_static_boundaries: handled state restored before integer-only commit
failed handoff retains no new raw descriptor
new resource at same retired integer stays live after rejected Session disposal
canonical _io aliases checked before module profile creation and every call
parent epoch initializer cannot publish in forked child
actual Popen remains visible only for genuine remaining resource ownership
